slots.name: prize amount
slots.sentence: The explosive, cathartic rocker “Bobby” gives way, in its final moment, to a sound collage featuring a recording of a scammy robot voice informing the listener that they have been selected to win “$18.5 million and a brand-new 2021 Mercedes-Benz in the color of your choice.”

slots.name: Hutson co-written tracks
slots.sentence: Bridgers’s boygenius compatriots sing backing vocals on the lovely bluegrass tune “Haunted” as well as the buoyant head-scratcher of a lead single “Lost Boys” — a decent song that is nonetheless unrepresentative of the rest of the album’s emotional gravity.
